evaluation_matrix: five standard kickoff layouts x both Rival sides, deterministic, 120 Hz, pinned Nexto
findings: The controlled curriculum elevated-contact counter did not transfer to high natural aerial contacts or goals.
The candidate learned frequent low airborne play and lost more than forty-six percent of V23's touch rate.
No productive floor landing or chained landing was observed in natural matches.
Authoritative demolitions increased from zero to seven, but none yielded a touch or goal within five seconds.
Training one V23 side parent and deploying it uniformly destroyed the accepted side-specialized competitive result.
